name: Can re-stucco help improve my home's insulation and energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can re-stucco help improve my home's insulation and energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional stucco itself offers some inherent insulation properties due to its mass, re-stuccoing can contribute to improved energy efficiency, particularly if combined with other measures. A new, properly applied stucco layer can seal minor cracks and gaps in your exterior, reducing air infiltration. For a more significant energy efficiency boost, some re-stucco projects incorporate an exterior insulation and finish system (EIFS) or a rainscreen system, which adds an insulating layer beneath the stucco. Discuss these options with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Re-stucco can improve energy efficiency by sealing gaps and reducing air infiltration. For more significant insulation, consider systems like EIFS or a rainscreen during the re-stucco process.
